tolerances.reason: The oracle page header prints the run timestamp (PRINTSPEC kind volatile; pinned by LEGACY_RUN_TS in the harness). The bridge has no such field, so it is excused, never compared.
The legacy program prints the 9-character tax id unmasked; the bridge must return mask(oracle value) = ***-**- + last four (LEGACY-BEHAVIOUR 5.9). An unmasked or wrongly masked bridge value fails.
